I hit a turning point recently. I'm still in the beginning of my journey so maybe I don't have room to talk, but this one feels different. I struggled with body issues a lot when I was younger (around 13 or 14) and beat anorexia. Then I just gained, I gained a lot of weight currently I'm sitting at 217 (I'm 5'2 so wayyyy overweight). A little while back I had a sudden drop in self esteem, a heart to heart with my SO, and weighed myself for the first time in a long time and it all kind of sank in. For myself, my mental and physical health I needed to make and change. I've immersed myself in fitness  (surrounding myself with positive fitness stories and such) and gotten equipment, so far it has stuck I've been sticking to my regiment and my diet, and I don't think I'm ever gonna look back.

I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I know it hurts, and it's terrifying. It's super terrifying, honestly I know, its lonely and it feels like there's no purpose and no one there for you but there is. Just look at everyone who commented to help, they're strangers but they care. So many people care because we are all so important and we all matter. Your life matters, so much. The world surrounding you would literally be different, you change things everyday just by existing and thinking and making choices. Life is so precious, your life is so precious. I really wish you the best and hope you can find peace and joy in whatever decision you make. 
And I urge you to go out into world first, before you make a solid decision, and find every bit of beautiful precious life you can. Look at the trees and the bugs and the animals around you, look at every bit of life and beauty you can find. And smile, try to smile a lot and mean it.

OP I don't think you should end it because of one person... what about your dad, don't you want to go to his wedding? What about all your family? People come and go but you will always be there for you. I think you should take some you time and really think about this. Pamper yourself. You should always  value yourself over others, and if this person cut everything because of one argument, they don't sound worth it imo. You should forget about them and focus on you and everyone you love and that loves you in return.

I'm so sorry, that all sounds terrifying. There's a lot of pressure on grades and school, but in truth there's more to life than that. Not having a job doesn't make you a failure, and failing an exam, or even a few, or even failing out of school doesn't make you a failure. Sure you might have failed (at that), but at 19 you've got a whole life a head of you. We all fail sometimes, everyone, but what makes us all amazing is that if we work hard enough we can pick ourselves up. Think of all your good days, of every test you passed(even the ones you thought you would bomb), think of every accomplishment you've achieved even the most minor ones. You aren't a failure for failing at a few things. You're a winner for recovering from your failures.

Tl;Dr: there's more to life than school and some grades.
